sehemu: Part III: Procedure, Powers and Privileges of Parliament
jina: Quorum at sittings of the National Assembly
maudhui: (1) The quorum at every sitting of the National Assembly shall be half of all the Members of Parliament. (2) Except where otherwise provided in this Constitution, every question proposed for decision by the National Assembly shall be determined by a majority of the votes of the Members present and voting. (3) The Speaker, Deputy Speaker or any other person presiding at a sitting of the National Assembly shall not have an original vote but shall have a casting vote in the event of an equality of votes. (4) The Standing Orders may provide that any Member who votes on a matter in which he has a personal interest shall be deemed not to have voted.
vifungu: (1) The quorum at every sitting of the National Assembly shall be half of all the Members of Parliament.

(2) Except where otherwise provided in this Constitution, every question proposed for decision by the National Assembly shall be determined by a majority of the votes of the Members present and voting.
(3) The Speaker, Deputy Speaker or any other person presiding at a sitting of the National Assembly shall not have an original vote but shall have a casting vote in the event of an equality of votes.
(4) The Standing Orders may provide that any Member who votes on a matter in which he has a personal interest shall be deemed not to have voted.
